captions.instagram:
Myth: you’re the only one who touches yourself.

In a Nigerian study of 941 sexually active adults aged 18–45 in Ibadan, 64.9% said they had ever masturbated: 62.4% of the women and 69.9% of the men.

Most people do it. Almost nobody says so out loud, so everyone thinks they’re the only one. It’s normal, and it’s yours.

Send this to the friend who needs to hear it.

Source: Bello et al., BMC Public Health, 2025. Face-to-face interviews in Ibadan, Nigeria.

#MythVsFact #SexualWellness #SelfLove #PleasureIsSelfCare #NoShame #Intimova
